mechanics.label: Mechanics
mechanics.description: Nexo mechanics (Furniture, Custom Block, Backpack, Commands …)

validation.range: Expects a number or a range such as 1..3
validation.resource: Expects a key such as namespace:path (lowercase only)

pullingModels.label: Pulling Models
pullingModels.description: Bow/crossbow: models while drawing – usually 3 stages.

fireworkModel.label: Firework Model
fireworkModel.description: Crossbow: loaded with a firework rocket (optional).

blockingModel.label: Blocking Model
blockingModel.hint: Instead of the SHIELD material, the “Blocks Attacks” component can be used from 1.21.5 on.

throwingModel.label: Throwing Model
throwingModel.description: Trident: while winding up to throw – usually the rotated main model.
throwingModel.hint: Set the look in flight, damage and sounds under “Mechanics → Trident”.

damagedModels.label: Damaged Models
damagedModels.description: Models shown one after another as durability decreases.
damagedModels.hint: The item needs durability (a material with durability or the “Max Damage” component).

dyeableModel.label: Dyeable Model
dyeableModel.description: Model shown when the item has been dyed (/nexo dye).
dyeableModel.hint: For dyeing, the faces in the model must have “Tint” enabled (Blockbench: Paint tab → Tint).

compositeModels.label: Composite Models
compositeModels.description: Several models drawn on top of each other (e.g. background, item, overlay).

guiModel.label: GUI Model
guiModel.description: A different model in the inventory (e.g. a flat 2D image), while the main model is shown in hand, on the head or as furniture.
guiModel.hint: ResourcepackBuilder generates its own ItemModel for this (Minecraft 1.21.4+). Pulling, Blocking and the like then no longer apply.

connectStraight.label: Straight
connectStraight.description: Middle piece between the left and right end

placementFloor.label: Floor
placementFloor.description: Placed on top of a block

placementWall.label: Wall
placementWall.description: Attached to the side of a block

lightOn.label: Toggled (Light On)
lightOn.description: Model when the light is switched on

stackModels.label: Stackable
stackModels.description: Additional models when the same block is placed several times in one spot (like pink petals).

shaped.label: Shaped
shaped.description: Crafting table: ingredients must be arranged in a specific pattern.

shapeless.label: Shapeless
shapeless.description: Crafting table: ingredients can be anywhere in the grid.

stonecutting.label: Stonecutting
stonecutting.description: One ingredient is processed in a stonecutter.

other.label: Other values
other.description: Values without their own form (e.g. from imported configs)

rawYaml.label: Additional YAML (YAML tab)
rawYaml.description: The content of the YAML tab

recipes.label: Recipes
recipes.description: Crafting recipes – caution: identical recipes for several items conflict in game

drop.label: Drops
drop.help: Without “Loot” entries the item drops itself.

silktouch.label: Silk Touch drops the block itself

furnitureStates.label: States (cycle by clicking)
furnitureStates.help: Each click switches to the next state; the default state is always included. Upload models for the states in the “Model & Pack” tab.

textEntities.label: Text displays
textEntities.help: Floating text (glyphs too) on the furniture, e.g. a sign or a price display.

clickActions.label: Click actions
clickActions.help: Actions: [console] command, [player] command, [message] text, [actionbar] text, '{'source=AMBIENT volume=1 pitch=1'}' [sound] sound

lore.label: Lore
lore.description: Text lines below the item name (MiniMessage, e.g. '<'gray>).

unbreakable.label: Unbreakable
unbreakable.description: The item does not lose durability.

excludeFromInventory.label: Exclude From Inventory
excludeFromInventory.description: The item does not appear in /nexo inventory but can still be given with /nexo give.

excludeFromCommands.label: Exclude From Commands
excludeFromCommands.description: The item does not show up in command completion (e.g. for helper items).

template.label: Template
template.description: Inherits all properties of another Nexo item.

itemFlags.label: ItemFlags
itemFlags.description: Hides parts of the tooltip. From 1.21.5 on, prefer the “Tooltip Display” component.

persistentData.label: PersistentData
persistentData.description: Custom data in the item''s PersistentDataContainer (PublicBukkitValues).

color.label: Color
color.description: Tints dyeable items (e.g. leather armor) or faces with “Tint” in the model.

packOversizedInGui.label: Oversized In GUI
packOversizedInGui.description: Lets models extend beyond the 16×16 slot in the inventory.

packCustomModelData.label: Custom Model Data (Pack)
packCustomModelData.description: Only needed if other plugins must recognize the item by CustomModelData. Otherwise Nexo assigns it itself.

armor.label: CustomArmor (Armor, Elytra, Mob Armor, Harness, Saddles)
armor.description: Texture shown when worn: player armor, elytra wings, armor for wolf/horse/llama/nautilus, harness for the happy ghast, or saddles. ResourcepackBuilder generates an equipment model in the pack from it and sets Components.equippable (slot, asset_id, allowed animals).
armor.hint: All parts of a set get the same set ID; the textures only need to be uploaded on one part. Elytras, animal armor and saddles each need their own set ID.

elytra.label: Elytra wings
elytra.help: Like elytra.png. Without material ELYTRA, ResourcepackBuilder adds the glider component automatically.

saddles.label: Saddles (1.21.5+)
saddles.help: A saddle can have textures for several animals.

attributeModifiers.label: AttributeModifiers
attributeModifiers.description: Changes values such as attack damage, speed or health.

enchantments.label: Enchantments
enchantments.description: Fixed enchantments – even above the vanilla maximum (e.g. Sharpness 15).

componentsMaxStackSize.label: Max Stack Size
componentsMaxStackSize.description: How many items fit into one slot (1–99).

componentsMaxDamage.label: Max Damage
componentsMaxDamage.description: Maximum durability of the item. Items with durability should have a stack size of 1.

componentsEnchantmentGlintOverride.label: Enchantment Glint Override
componentsEnchantmentGlintOverride.description: Forces (true) or prevents (false) the enchantment glint.

componentsFireResistant.label: Fire Resistant
componentsFireResistant.description: The item does not burn in fire and lava.

componentsHideTooltip.label: Hide Tooltip
componentsHideTooltip.description: No tooltip is shown on hover.

componentsTooltipDisplay.label: Tooltip Display
componentsTooltipDisplay.description: Hides individual components in the tooltip. Replaces the item flags from 1.21.5 on.

componentsFood.label: Food
componentsFood.description: Makes the item edible. For eating time, animation and effects, also add “Consumable”.

componentsConsumable.label: Consumable
componentsConsumable.description: The item can be used/consumed (duration, animation, sound, effects).

componentsUseRemainder.label: Use Remainder
componentsUseRemainder.description: Item left behind after consumption (e.g. an empty bottle).

componentsTool.label: Tool
componentsTool.description: Mining speed and rules for specific blocks.

componentsWeapon.label: Weapon
componentsWeapon.description: Durability loss per attack and shield disabling.

componentsEquippable.label: Equippable
componentsEquippable.description: The item can be worn like armor (e.g. a 3D hat on the head).
componentsEquippable.hint: For a 3D helmet: use slot HEAD and leave asset_id empty.

damageOnHurt.label: Takes damage when the wearer is hit

componentsGlider.label: Glider
componentsGlider.description: Allows gliding like elytra while the item is worn (together with “Equippable”).

componentsDamageResistant.label: Damage Resistant
componentsDamageResistant.description: The item (as an entity) is immune to this damage type tag.

componentsRepairable.label: Repairable
componentsRepairable.description: Vanilla items or tags that repair the item in an anvil.

componentsDeathProtection.label: Death Protection
componentsDeathProtection.description: Protects the player from death while the item is held.

componentsJukeboxPlayable.label: Jukebox Playable
componentsJukeboxPlayable.description: The item can be put into a jukebox and plays a song.

componentsTooltipStyle.label: Tooltip Style
componentsTooltipStyle.description: Custom tooltip background from the resource pack (textures/gui/sprites/tooltip/'<'key>_frame/_background).

componentsBreakSound.label: Break Sound
componentsBreakSound.description: Sound when the durability runs out.

componentsCanPlaceOn.label: Can Place On
componentsCanPlaceOn.description: Blocks the item may be placed on in adventure mode.

componentsCanBreak.label: Can Break
componentsCanBreak.description: Blocks the item may break in adventure mode.

componentsProfile.label: Profile
componentsProfile.description: Skin for items with material PLAYER_HEAD. Specify a name, UUID or properties.

componentsCustomModelData.label: Custom Model Data
componentsCustomModelData.description: New CustomModelData format (floats, flags, strings, colors) – for custom ItemModels.

componentsCustomData.label: Custom Data
componentsCustomData.description: Data directly in the item''s custom_data section.

componentsUnsetComponents.label: Unset Components
componentsUnsetComponents.description: Removes components the base material normally has (e.g. minecraft:tool).

componentsBlocksAttacks.label: Blocks Attacks
componentsBlocksAttacks.description: The item can block attacks like a shield.

componentsAttackRange.label: Attack Range
componentsAttackRange.description: Reach and hitbox margin of the weapon.

componentsPiercingWeapon.label: Piercing Weapon
componentsPiercingWeapon.description: Behavior when the weapon pierces targets (spear).

componentsSwingAnimation.label: Swing Animation
componentsSwingAnimation.description: Animation when swinging. Replaced by attack and interact animations from 26.3 on.

componentsUseEffects.label: Use Effects
componentsUseEffects.description: Sprinting, vibrations and movement speed while using.

componentsDamageType.label: Damage Type
componentsDamageType.description: The type of damage the item deals.

componentsMinimumAttackCharge.label: Minimum Attack Charge
componentsMinimumAttackCharge.description: How full the attack indicator must be (0–1).

componentsCompostable.label: Compostable
componentsCompostable.description: How many layers the item fills in a composter.

componentsCookingFuel.label: Cooking Fuel
componentsCookingFuel.description: The item can be burned in a furnace.

componentsBrewingFuel.label: Brewing Fuel
componentsBrewingFuel.description: The item can be used as fuel in a brewing stand.

mechanicsFurniture.label: Furniture
mechanicsFurniture.description: The item is placed as furniture (item display) – with hitbox, seats, light and more.

hitbox.label: Hitbox
hitbox.help: Barriers are solid 1×1 blocks; interactions scale freely but have no collision.

toggledItemModel.label: ItemModel when switched on (empty = uploaded “Toggled” model)

connectable.label: Connectable
connectable.help: Identical furniture placed side by side connects, e.g. chairs into a sofa. Upload the models (Straight, Left, Right, Inner, Outer) in the “Model & Pack” tab – this is then set automatically.

item.label: ITEM – a separate Nexo item per connection

previewPlacement.label: Placement preview
previewPlacement.help: Leave empty for the default values.

placements.label: Placement variants (floor/wall/roof)
placements.help: Upload custom models for Floor, Wall and Roof in the “Model & Pack” tab. Here you can override further values per variant.

mechanicsCustomBlock.label: Custom Block
mechanicsCustomBlock.description: The item is placed as a real block (NoteBlock, StringBlock or ChorusBlock).
mechanicsCustomBlock.hint: For blocks, Nexo recommends a non-block material such as PAPER. This item''s model is used automatically.

customVariation.label: Variation (unique number)
customVariation.help: Leave empty to let Nexo assign a free number automatically. Do not change it once blocks have been placed!

directional.label: Orientation when placed (like logs)
directional.help: Nexo rotates the model depending on the direction and assigns the required variations itself.

strippedLog.label: Turns into (item ID of the stripped block)

sapling.label: Sapling (grows into a schematic)
sapling.help: The schematics must be in the plugins/Nexo/schematics folder (WorldEdit/FAWE).

mechanicsCommands.label: Commands
mechanicsCommands.description: Runs commands on use (as console, player or OP). %p% = player name.

mechanicsCustom.label: Custom Mechanic
mechanicsCustom.description: Event → conditions → actions, no programming needed.
mechanicsCustom.hint: Actions: [console] command, [player] command, [message] text, [actionbar] text, '{'source=AMBIENT volume=1 pitch=1'}' [sound] sound. Placeholder: '<'player>

mechanicsArmorEffects.label: Armor Effects
mechanicsArmorEffects.description: Potion effects while the item is worn.

mechanicsTrident.label: Trident
mechanicsTrident.description: Throwing behavior of an item with material TRIDENT: damage, sounds and look of the thrown trident.
mechanicsTrident.hint: Upload a custom model for throwing in the “Model & Pack” tab under “Special Item Appearance → Throwing Model”.

thrownItem.label: Different Nexo item in flight (item ID)

mechanicsRepair.label: Repair
mechanicsRepair.description: This item can repair other items in the inventory (drag the item onto the damaged item).

mechanicsMisc.label: Misc
mechanicsMisc.description: Small behavior tweaks such as preventing renaming or allowing vanilla recipes.

preventItemFrames.label: Cannot be put in item frames

mechanicsSoulbound.label: Soulbound
mechanicsSoulbound.description: The item stays in the inventory on death.

mechanicsHarvesting.label: Harvesting
mechanicsHarvesting.description: Automatically harvests and replants ripe crops in the area.

mechanicsSmelting.label: Smelting
mechanicsSmelting.description: Ores are smelted instantly when mined (supports Fortune and Silk Touch).

mechanicsItemtype.label: ItemType
mechanicsItemtype.description: Changes the tool type for Nexo blocks (the type must be defined in mechanics.yml).

generated.label: 2D item
generated.description: Flat item like paper or gems. Further PNGs are stacked on top as additional layers.

handheld.label: 2D tool / weapon
handheld.description: Like item/generated, but held at an angle in the hand like a sword or pickaxe.

handheldRod.label: 2D rod / fishing rod
handheldRod.description: Held in the hand like a fishing rod or a stick.

cubeAll.label: Block – one texture
cubeAll.description: Cube with the same texture on all sides (e.g. ore, stone).

cubeBottomTop.label: Block – top/bottom/side
cubeBottomTop.description: Separate textures for top, bottom and the sides (e.g. sandstone).

cube.label: Block – six sides
cube.description: Every side gets its own texture.

cross.label: Plant (cross)
cross.description: Two crossed planes like flowers – ideal for StringBlocks.
